title: Implement capture integrity and provenance reporting
description:
Create CaptureIntegrity that accumulates per-capture provenance metadata and produces a structured integrity report after recording completes.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/recording/ for the recorder class and any existing format/sample-rate negotiation results.
- src/pipewire/ for how the negotiated stream format (sample format, rate, channels) is exposed.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. CaptureIntegrity tracks: source stream name, negotiated sample format and rate, file sample format and rate, whether the capture is native (negotiated == file), quantized (bit-depth reduced), resampled (rate changed), or converted (both).
2. Expose an enum CaptureKind { Native, Quantized, Resampled, Converted } and a human-readable label for each.
3. Record xrun count, total frames captured, capture duration, and file path.
4. Provide a toJson() method returning a QJsonObject with all provenance fields.
5. Provide a summary() method returning a single-line human-readable string that includes CaptureKind and file path.
6. The class is a plain C++ value type (no Q_OBJECT needed). Header-only or header+cpp is acceptable.
7. No file I/O beyond what the caller passes in; CaptureIntegrity does not open or write files itself.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/recording/CaptureIntegrity.hpp declares CaptureIntegrity with CaptureKind enum, toJson(), and summary() methods

src/recording/CaptureIntegrity.cpp implements toJson() returning a QJsonObject with keys: sourceStream, negotiatedFormat, negotiatedRate, fileFormat, fileRate, captureKind, xrunCount, totalFrames, durationSeconds, filePath
CaptureKind is Native when negotiated format/rate equals file format/rate, Quantized when only bit-depth differs, Resampled when only rate differs, Converted when both differ
summary() includes the CaptureKind label and file path in a single line
